LanguageData.AyameICCT_Changfen.label: plain rice noodle rolls
LanguageData.AyameICCT_Changfen.description:
Preliminary drawer-style rice noodle rolls with no filling, no side dishes, and not even a soy sauce packet, commonly known as 'plain changfen'. Soft without sticking, loose without clumping, tender, smooth, and savory.
It can be further cooked into other foods, or heated and eaten directly, though it tastes rather plain on its own.
Its origin in the cosmos is disputed, but rimworld locals independently figured out how to make it.
As a refined carbohydrate processed food, it is also hard currency gladly bought by traders.
LanguageData.AyameICCT_ZhuChangfen.label: chee cheong fun
LanguageData.AyameICCT_ZhuChangfen.description:
Preliminary rolled rice noodles with no filling, side dishes, or sauce. The rice sheet is white as snow, thin as paper, and as tender and smooth as a young girl's skin.
It can be further cooked into other foods, and pairs well with chili soy sauce or sweet sauces.
It can also be heated and eaten directly, though it tastes rather plain on its own.
As a refined carbohydrate processed food, it is also hard currency gladly bought by traders.
